svg.text: Smart Safe Guardian — Hardware Wiring Diagram
Vault node (YoloUNO · ESP32-S3), wearable badge (Yolo:Bit · ESP32) and edge gateway.
All Grove modules use 3.3 V logic: no level shifter or pull-up resistor is needed.
C submit · B ack · E pair
badge → vault: UNLOCK · LOCK · ACK · PAIR
A + B: released < 1.5 s → FAKE_BADGE (rogue test) · held ≥ 1.5 s → PAIR_REQ
